_doc: One entry per game animation: name -> prompt + seconds. Each becomes <name>_s0.bvh and <name>_s1.bvh (two takes). Prompts say 'in place' where the colonist shouldn't travel; root motion is removed on retarget anyway.

clips.name: idle
clips.prompt: A person stands in place, relaxed, shifting their weight and looking around.

clips.name: walk
clips.prompt: A person walks forward at a relaxed pace.

clips.name: carry
clips.prompt: A person walks forward carrying a heavy box in front of them with both hands.

clips.name: chop
clips.prompt: A person stands in place and chops wood, swinging an axe down from over their shoulder again and again.

clips.name: mine
clips.prompt: A person stands in place and swings a pickaxe down at a rock repeatedly.

clips.name: gather
clips.prompt: A person bends down and picks berries from a low bush with one hand, again and again.

clips.name: build
clips.prompt: A person stands in place hammering a nail into a wall at chest height, again and again.

clips.name: farm
clips.prompt: A person stands in place digging the soil with a hoe, pulling it toward them repeatedly.

clips.name: draw_water
clips.prompt: A person pulls a rope hand over hand to lift a bucket out of a well.

clips.name: eat
clips.prompt: A person stands and eats food from their hand, chewing.

clips.name: drink
clips.prompt: A person lifts a cup to their mouth and drinks, then lowers it.

clips.name: sit
clips.prompt: A person sits down on the ground cross-legged and rests.

clips.name: lie_down
clips.prompt: A person lies down on the ground on their back and goes to sleep.

clips.name: talk
clips.prompt: A person stands talking to someone in front of them, gesturing with their hands.

clips.name: wave
clips.prompt: A person waves hello with their right hand.

clips.name: celebrate
clips.prompt: A person cheers with both arms raised in the air.
